question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?

question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?

Attribution is also getting harder, since firms frame cuts as restructuring while expanding AI-adjacent hiring. No new evidence this week pushes toward or away from the one-third threshold.
